question: In Melanoma trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.

        WHEN follow_up_duration_overall_months < 12 THEN '<12'
        WHEN follow_up_duration_overall_months BETWEEN 12 AND 23 THEN '12–23'
        ELSE '≥24'
    END AS follow_up_duration_bucket,
